incident.summary: A fresh Figma upload_assets submit URL was incorrectly followed by a direct chat-runtime HTTP POST attempt even though the existing GitHub Actions Figma upload relay had already been deployed and proven.
incident.root_cause: Execution routing failed to treat the previously proven relay as the mandatory transport for raster bytes when the chat runtime lacks direct public egress. This was not a new Figma defect and not a loss of prior relay capability.

mandatory_route.applies_to: Any future raster/image byte binding to Figma via upload_assets submitUrl in this VPD project.
sequence: Obtain fresh upload_assets submitUrl for the intended target node.
Use the existing encrypted GitHub Actions Figma Upload Relay V1 to transport image bytes and submitUrl.
Do not default to direct HTTP POST from the ChatGPT/container runtime.
Do not ask the user to switch to local Codex/manual upload unless the established relay itself has been tested and has a specific new failure.
After relay execution, independently read back the target Figma node/image fill and screenshot the containing frame before claiming success.
